title: AC1024 associative constraint-group same-input node-tail runtime
scope: Execute an independent DWG reader against the exact AC1024 mechanical source used by the earlier conflicting LibreDWG projections, and establish the observed constraint-group node framing without treating peer output as consumer or support qualification.

observation.versionNote: acadrust normalizes the legacy source version-0 group into model version 2; the model value is not the source version field.
observation.decodedVectorNote: The first vector entry is an empty in-memory sentinel; it is not serialized.

representativeNode.classData: Geometrical { owner_id: 0, is_implied: false, is_active: true }

observation.parserProfile: For the source version-0 layout, after the action list the reader consumes a next-node-ID seed followed by an inline node count; each serialized node then carries class-name text, node ID, connection count/vector, and class-specific data. The node class decoder documents that version-0 geometrical constraints have no serialized active flag.

previousProjectionConflict.finding: The prior JSON and DXF projections disagree about the first node's connections. The same-input acadrust runtime decodes an inline node list and concrete connection vectors; do not treat the DXF value 1073741825 as a source connection field.

interpretation.completed: Same-input independent peer execution reconciles the earlier node-tail profile conflict sufficiently to begin a bounded implementation slice.
